context: Request: all Capital Markets matters that included a Rule 144A or Regulation S tranche, with offering documents and records of structure and closing. Rubric: 1005-00002, 1014-00001, 1016-00003, 1021-00002, 1039-00002, 1045-00001 as closed qualifying matters, 1020-00003 as an executed-but-terminated precedent, proof documents for each, plus precision.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Depth-limited finds return nothing; it lists the workspace, then the first 100 files under the matters folder.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find piped to grep over file paths for offering-document words, cut at 300 lines by its own head limit.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide text scan for tranche terms; times out with partial output.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Narrower find piped to grep over file paths, written to a file and printed in full.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the offering memorandum, closing memo and purchase agreement of one candidate and the global notes of another; one guessed path does not exist.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of five candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads memos and offering memoranda of three more candidates.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads closing memos, an exemption memo, a closing email and a purchase agreement of candidates already opened.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes four matters as closed comparables and screens out others.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The full file-name list showed every qualifying matter, but it opened five, judged one of them not closed, and never opened two others.

first_error.why: Its full file-name list showed two more qualifying matters, but the five matters it chose to list left them out and it never opened them.

other_errors.why: Read one matter's internal memo and offering supplement and treated it as not closed, although a closing checklist sat in the file list it had just printed (evidence seen at [25]-[31]).
Kept another qualifying matter in the answer but did not state that it closed.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a read on the store folder, which fails because it is a directory.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: A store-wide content grep for tranche terms, with three reads of a listing-top matter in parallel (labelled by the grep, which set the next steps); the grep's line list covers a limited set of matters.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of six candidates from the grep lines.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Four batches of reads of offering memoranda, closing memos, emails and checklists of six candidates.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes six responsive matters and one comparator.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits the summary paragraph.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: One content grep missed three qualifying matters; of those it opened, one was judged not closed, and two non-qualifying matters were added.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its only search was one content grep whose line list never reached three qualifying matters; it did not search file names or run another grep.

other_errors.why: Read one matter's pre-closing email and checklist and treated it as priced but not closed (evidence seen at [27]-[35]).
Asserted two non-qualifying matters as responsive.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a depth-limited find that returns nothing.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Lists matter subfolders and greps file paths for offering-document words; its own sorted line cap stops the file list among the early-numbered matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads six documents of the one candidate in that list.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide text scan for tranche terms; times out with partial output.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads memos, an offering memorandum, indentures and an opinion of two matters from the scan output.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Re-reads one candidate's indenture and opinion and lists the files of two candidates (labelled by the reads).

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists files of three matters and reads two documents of a listing-top matter (labelled by the listings).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads and lists two more matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the offering memorandum, closing memo, funds flow and checklist of one candidate and the purchase agreement of another.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes three completed matters.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: A self-capped file-name list and a timed-out scan surfaced only two qualifying matters; it answered with those and one non-qualifying matter.

first_error.stage: Search file names for request keywords
first_error.why: Its file-name search was cut by its own line cap before reaching most matters and its later text scan timed out; it reran neither, so five qualifying matters never surfaced.

other_errors.why: Asserted a non-qualifying matter as a completed comparable.

divergence: All three failed, at different search or selection stages. T0's uncapped file-name search listed every qualifying matter, but it chose five to list and skipped two (surfaced-not-opened at the listing stage). T1 relied on one content grep whose line list missed three matters (search-miss at its first search stage). T2's file-name search was cut by its own line cap and its scan timed out (search-miss at the file-name stage). T0 and T1 also judged an opened matter as not closed; T1 and T2 added non-qualifying matters.
